description: Create React frontend workspace package (frontend/) with Vite, React 18, React Router, and AWS Amplify libraries for Cognito authentication. Implement the full UI: login, project CRUD, slide generation/preview/edit/approve workflow, video generation with job progress, deliverable download, and video player. Add API Gateway teaser endpoint. Update CDK with Amplify Hosting construct and teaser API route.
steps: Add 'frontend' to pnpm-workspace.yaml packages list
Create frontend/package.json with React 18, react-router-dom, @aws-amplify/ui-react, aws-amplify, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, vitest, typescript deps
Create frontend/tsconfig.json and frontend/tsconfig.build.json following project conventions (strict, ES2022, React JSX)
Create frontend/vite.config.ts with React plugin, proxy to API Gateway in dev, and build output to dist/
Create frontend/index.html entry point
Create frontend/src/main.tsx (React root with Amplify.configure using env vars for Cognito pool, region, API endpoint)
Create frontend/src/App.tsx with React Router routes: /login, /projects, /projects/:id, /projects/:id/versions/:version, /projects/:id/videos
Create frontend/src/amplify-config.ts reading VITE_COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID, VITE_COGNITO_CLIENT_ID, VITE_API_ENDPOINT from environment
Create frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts using Amplify Auth for signIn, signOut, getCurrentUser, getIdToken
Create frontend/src/api/client.ts - typed API client wrapping fetch with Authorization: Bearer <idToken> header, base URL from env
Create frontend/src/api/types.ts - import and re-export relevant types from @slide-first/shared-types
Create frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx - Amplify Authenticator component for Cognito login/signup
Create frontend/src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx - list projects, create project form (title, description)
Create frontend/src/pages/ProjectDetailPage.tsx - show project info, versions list, start slide generation form (theme, audience, duration, URLs)
Create frontend/src/pages/VersionPage.tsx - display generated Marp markdown preview (rendered HTML), edit capability, approve button
Create frontend/src/pages/VideosPage.tsx - start full video, start teaser video buttons, job progress display with polling, deliverable download links, video player component
Create frontend/src/components/MarkdownPreview.tsx - render Marp markdown as HTML preview (simple rendered view)
Create frontend/src/components/JobProgress.tsx - poll GET /v1/jobs/:jobId every 3s, show status/progress bar
Create frontend/src/components/VideoPlayer.tsx - HTML5 video player with CloudFront signed URL
Create frontend/src/components/DeliverablesList.tsx - fetch and display downloadable deliverables (PDF, PPTX, MP4, VTT, SRT)
Create frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx - app shell with navigation, auth state display
Add unit tests: frontend/src/api/client.test.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.test.ts
Add POST /v1/projects/{id}/videos/teaser route to lambdas/api/src/index.ts route table
Create lambdas/api/src/handlers/teaser.ts - similar to videos.ts but starts teaser generation (outputTypes: ['x-teaser-16x9'])
Add teaser handler test: lambdas/api/src/handlers/teaser.test.ts
Update infra/lib/api-construct.ts to add teaser route: POST /v1/projects/{id}/videos/teaser
Create infra/lib/frontend-construct.ts - S3 bucket for SPA hosting + CloudFront distribution (or reference existing DeliveryConstruct pattern)
Update infra/src/main-stack.ts to include FrontendConstruct
Update infra/test/main-stack.test.ts to assert frontend resources exist
Ensure pnpm build, pnpm test, and pnpm lint all pass
acceptance_criteria: frontend/ package builds (tsc and vite build) without errors
Frontend has working login page with Amplify Authenticator
Frontend has project creation and listing pages
Frontend has slide generation, preview, and approve workflow pages
Frontend has video generation with progress polling and deliverable download
POST /v1/projects/{id}/videos/teaser endpoint exists and is tested
pnpm build and pnpm test pass across all workspace packages
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && pnpm install && pnpm build
